subject.note: The isolated copy is a shared local clone checked out at the base and overlaid with every modified and untracked file of the worktree; git diff of the copy and of the worktree hash identically, and every untracked file matched by sha256.

method: replay.mjs.txt replays each control of ../repair-controls.json: positive arm, recorded reversion (base file or exact old/new needle with its count), npm run build when a .ts file is reverted, negative arm, restore and rebuild. Demonstrated requires positive exit 0 with no failed case and negative exit 1 with a failed case. Each arm runs under node scripts/harness.mjs bounded.
environmentNote: The first run of browser-signal and browser-recovery failed its positive arm too: the case sets PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH to <checkout>/.runtime/playwright, an ignored directory the copy lacked, so Chromium never launched (browser witness did not reach the wait step). Rerun with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH set to the worktree pinned Chromium, both demonstrate. Both runs are listed.
